fields.quoted_span:
No residential landlord may evict or fail to renew a 
lease, whether it is a written or an oral lease without good cause.
fields.note: The listed causes, the Notice to Quit and Notice to Cease rules, the self-help ban, the relocation assistance, the owner-occupied and rooming-house provisions and the misuse penalties all match the guide.

fields.quoted_span:
Any tenant evicted under G 3) (illegal occupancy) is entitled to relocation assistance in 
an amount equal to six times the tenant’s monthly rent.
fields.note: The notice periods (3 days, 1 month, 2 months, 3 months, 18 months, 3 years) match the guide's cause-by-cause provisions. Treble damages and the $10,000 civil penalty are also stated.
The guide gives no effective date for the Act, and the field is null.
